title: Reports
acceptance_criteria: 13.9.1 Chief Controller Office shall be able to generate Assets related reports as follows: a. b. c. d. e. f. g. h. i. j. Allocation Summary by ReqCen. This report shall generate CR allocation summary details by ReqCen. Allocation Summary by Service. This report shall generate CR allocation summary details by Services (e.g. Army, RSAF, RSN, DIS, etc). Allocation Summary by Unit/EE. This report shall generate CR allocation summary details by Unit/EE. Allocated CR Owners. This report shall generate the allocated CR Owner with summary information of their CR assets by CR category. Unallocated CR Owners. This report shall generate all unallocated CR Owners with summary information of their CR assets by CR category. ReqCen CR Requirements vs CR Owner Allocation. This report shall generate ReqCen CR requirements and allocated CR Owner details. Unit/EE CR Requirements vs CR Owner Allocation. This report shall generate Unit/EE CR requirements and allocated CR Owner details. ReqCen Unit/EE Asset Allocation. This report shall generate individual asset allocation to Unit/EE. ReqCen Allocated CR Owner Details. This report shall generate CR Owners summary details. Unmap Mobile Crane. This report shall generate all unmapped mobile crane details. k. l. m. n. o. Heavy Plants and LTA Registered Assets. This report shall generate heavy plant and LTA registered assets per CR summary details. Vessels and Craft CR Owner. This report shall generate vessels and craft CR Owners summary details to facilitate Controllers in sourcing quotations. National Resource Pool Vessel and Craft. This report shall generate vessels and craft CR details to facilitate Controllers in asset allocation. Vessels and Craft CR Owner Allocation. This report shall generate vessels and craft CR Owner summary details to facilitate Controllers in asset allocation. Exemption Request. This report shall generate EE exemption requests.

13.9.2 p. RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 Exemption Request with Error. This report shall generate EE requests with error. q. ReqCen Exercise Planning – Allocated CR Owners and Categories. This report shall generate the allocated CR owners and CR categories to facilitate ReqCen’s CR exercise planning. It shall allow users to select the single or multiple ReqCens. The output shall include details such as  Date CR owner was last exercised.  Date CR owner was last exercise by the ReqCen.  Date CR category was last exercised.  Date CR category was last exercised by the ReqCen. r. CR Owners Exercise Details. This report shall generate CR Owners that have participated in past CR exercises and details of their participation. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. exercise date range, CR Owner, ReqCen, etc. s. List of CR Owners Exercised. This report shall generate a summary of CR Owners that have participated in past CR exercises. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. exercise date range, ReqCen, etc. t. EMA Ops Hourly Status Report. This report shall generate Requisitioned, De- Requisitioned, Issued, Returned, Rejection hourly status for exercise and operations requisition plans. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. exercise date range, ReqCen, Requisition Plan, etc. u. CR Owners Response Time. This report shall generate the response time of CR owners who had participated in CR exercises. v. Quantity of CR Owners/Assets Exercised and Compensation Made. This report shall generate approved and exercise quantity and compensation. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. exercise date range, CR Owner, ReqCen, etc. Chief Controller Office shall be able to generate Undertakings related reports as follows: a. b. c. Undertakings Requirement Approval Status Report. This report gives an overview of the status of requests for companies/firms by the requesting agency. The report also has information such as the approval dates by the various stakeholders given that each request is routed through multiple agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency, Submission From Dates and Current Status. Essential Firms (by Agency) Report. This report generates the list of firms by Requesting Agencies. When generating the report, Chief Controller Office shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Lead Agency and Allocated From Dates. Essential Firms (by Company) Report. This report generates the list of firms by company/firm. The report shall show if the Company is ‘Individual’ or ‘Shared’, and if it is ‘Shared’, it shall show the list of agencies that have

13.9.3 d. e. f. RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 registered the company. When generating the report, Chief Controller Office shall be able to select the period and registration status (e.g. all status, rejected, deregistered firms). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Coordinating Agency and the Allocated from dates. Undertakings Readiness (by Agency) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by Requesting Agencies. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. Undertakings Readiness (by Company) Report. This report generates a summary of firms’ readiness covering the E-Plan and Exercise status by company/firm. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and the range of the approval dates. Essential Firm Security Clearance Status Report. This report generates the status of security clearance of companies. When generating the report, Chief Controller Office shall be able to select the clearance status (e.g. all status, submitted, approved, pending, rejected). There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm and Security Clearance. g. Essential Firm Security Re-Clearance Report. This report generates the list of companies that are subjected to security re-clearance. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency, Essential Firm, Security Expiry Date, Re-clearance status. h. Schedule of Service Report. This report generates a listing of the Schedule of Service of the firms. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency and Essential Firm. i. Outstanding Service Acceptance. This report generated the list of outstanding service acceptance after TDPCUs have been served. There shall be optional fields for users to choose, e.g. Requesting Agency and Essential Firm. Chief Controller Office shall be able to generate Compensation related reports as follows: a. Appeal Report. This report generates appeal details. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range, CR type, Compensation type, etc. b. c. d. Asset Modification/Inspection Compensation Report. This report generates compensation report for CR asset without requisition plan, namely modification and inspection compensation. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range, Compensation Status, etc. Asset Modification/Inspection Payment Report (Homefront). This report generates payment report for CR asset without requisition plan, namely modification and inspection payment; consists of Homefront payments that go through manual payment. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range, etc. Asset Modification/Inspection Payment Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report generates payment report for CR asset without requisition plan, namely modification and inspection payment; consists of SAF payments that go OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)

13.9.4 through Payment Service Hub (PSH) or Enterprise System (ES) for payment. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range, etc. e. Asset Requisition Compensation Report. This report generates requisition compensation report for CR asset with requisition plan. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, Compensation Status, etc. f. Asset Requisition Payment Report (Homefront). This report generates requisition payment report for CR asset with requisition plan; consists of Homefront payments that go through manual payment. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name as the madatory field. g. Asset Requisition Payment Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report generates requisition payment report for CR asset with requisition plan; consists of SAF payments that go through PSH or ES for payment. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, etc. h. Timeliness Report. This report generates a timeline of verification, approval and payment processing for compensations. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range, CR type (assets or undertaking), Requisition Plan name, Compensation Type, etc. i. Undertakings Requisition Compensation Report. This report generates compensation report for undertakings requisition plan. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, Compensation Status, etc. j. Undertakings Requisition Payment Report (Homefront). This report generates payment report for undertakings requisition plan; consists of Homefront payments that go through manual payment. It shall allow users to select the Requisition Plan name, etc. k. Undertakings Requisition Payment Report (MINDEF/SAF). This report generates payment report for undertakings requisition plan; consists of MINDEF/SAF payment processed by DFO’s Payment Service Hub (PSH) or Enterprise System (ES). It shall allow users to select the Requisition plan name, etc. l. Verification Report. This report generates compensation count (pending verification and verified) for asset and undertakings. It shall allow users to define the range for selection, e.g. date range. Chief Controller Office shall be able to export/download the reports.

title: Dashboard
acceptance_criteria: 13.10.1 As Chief Controller Office, I want to generate and customise Dashboards so that I can have a quick insight of CR information for analysis, track compliance and monitor readiness. Asset Dashboard shall be divided into three key sections a. CR Allocation (Assets) focus on demand fulfilment status. b. CR Planning (Assets) focus on CR exercise policy compliance and Undertaking Readiness.
13.10.2 RFQ No. DEFNGPP7126100138 c. CR Requisition (Assets) focus on the overall requisition/ derequisition status and response time of CR owners especially during operations.
13.10.3 Asset Dashboards shall be displayed at three levels a. b. Aggregated at Level 1 – Display all (i.e. MINDEF/SAF and WOG).
13.10.4 Aggregated at Level 2 – Display at Service-level (i.e. Army, RSAF, RSN, DIS and WOG/SCDF). c. Aggregated at Level 3 – Display at ReqCen-level (e.g. ReqCen A, L1, R1, etc.).

13.10.5 When generating the dashboards, Chief Controller Office shall be able to select by specific period, e.g. Work-Year 2025 which refers to 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026. a. b. The results shall provide the statistics in numbers and percentage.

13.10.6 The dashboard shall use the traffic light system (green, amber, red) so that it draws the users’ attention to areas that are important or of concern. The respective performance target for green, amber and red shall be pre-defined and can be re-defined easily.
13.10.7 There shall be accompanying details to support the aggregated information and Chief Controller Office shall be able to export/download the information.
13.10.8 Undertakings Dashboard shall be divided into three key sections a. b. CR Allocation (Undertakings) focus on demand fulfilment status.

title: Manage Self-Sourced Assets
acceptance_criteria: 14.1.1 System shall support Controllers to manage self-sourced assets via upload of a. CRO self-sourced heavy plants (applicable for Controller Vehicles) b. NEA heavy plants information (applicable for Controller Vehicles) c. SCDF FISOPS information (applicable for Controller Vehicles) d. Self-sourced vessels information (applicable for Controller Vessels) e. CAAS aircraft information (applicable for Controller Aircraft) Controllers shall select the relevant templates, and the system will a. Display the list of self-sourced assets maintained in CRIPS and have a function to export/download the information.
14.1.2 Have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load into CRIPS.
14.1.3 Have a function to upload a filled template containing all the information needed to mass upload the self-sourced assets into CRIPS.

14.1.4 Controllers shall be able to view the existing list of self-sourced assets and have a function to de-register the assets (checkbox provided to support selection by individual or multiple assets).

14.1.5 System shall ensure that for some of the information (e.g. NEA heavy plant and SCDF FISOPS) updated in CRIPS, the information will be saved for processing by scheduled batch jobs (frequency to be determined later).

title: Approve Asset Exemption
acceptance_criteria: 14.2.1 System shall generate and trigger an email to the respective Controllers to notify him/her there is an asset exemption/un-exemption request pending his/her approval. If the request is not processed, an email shall be sent to the respective Controller every 7-day interval to remind him/her of the outstanding cases.

14.2.2 Controllers shall be able to approve or reject the request. If there are multiple assets listed in the same request, he/she can select single or multiple assets for approval OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
14.2.3 or rejection. When rejecting the request, Controller is required to state the reason(s) for the rejection.
14.2.4 System shall generate and trigger an email to Requester(Asset_SAF), Requestor(Asset_WOG) to inform him/her that Controller has processed the request and he/she shall check the status in CRIPS.

14.2.5 For assets exemption/un-exemption for a large list of CR assets, Controllers may prefer to review the request offline. Upon completion of the review, Controller shall be able to mass upload the list of CR assets he/she approve to exempt/un-exempt and system shall a. Have a function to download a template containing all the essential fields that shall be populated to support mass load into CRIPS. b. Have a function to upload a filled template containing all the information needed to mass upload the exempted assets into CRIPS.
14.2.6 System shall ensure that exempted assets cannot be allocated nor requisitioned.
14.2.7 When EMA_AO or EMA_EO attempt to requisition an exempted asset, system shall prompt appropriate message to inform him/her the asset is exempted from requisition.

title: Manage Asset Immunity
acceptance_criteria: 14.3.1 Controllers shall be able to manage immunity by CR Owner (UEN) and by asset registration number.
14.3.2 System shall allow each immunity record to have an effective start date and a free text field that Controllers are required to key in the immunity reference number.
14.3.3 Controllers shall be allowed to create, update, view and delete immunity cases. When deleting an immunity record, Controllers shall be prompted to enter the justification for the deletion.
14.3.4 Controllers shall be able to export/download immunity records.
14.3.5 Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Manage Asset Requirements
acceptance_criteria: 14.4.1 assets (i.e. vehicles, heavy plants, vessels, seacraft, aircraft) requirements and allocate CR supplies to meet the ReqCen/Unit/EE’s CR needs.

14.4.2 System shall restrict the display by CR types according to the respective Controller’s access rights, a. CR Vehicles, CR Heavy Plants (applicable for Controller Vehicles) b. CR Vessels, CR Craft (applicable for Controller Vessels) c. CR Aircraft (applicable for Controller Aircraft) Controllers shall be able to view details of CR asset requirements (e.g. Unit/EE, CR Type, CR Category, Quantity Required, Approving Authority, etc).
14.4.3 Controllers shall be able to view the allocation by CR category, including substitution CR category and the corresponding quantity allocated.

title: Manage ReqCen Allocation
acceptance_criteria: 14.5.1 System shall restrict by CR types according to the respective Controller’s access rights, a. CR Vehicles, CR Heavy Plants (applicable for Controller Vehicles) b. CR Vessels, CR Craft (applicable for Controller Vessels) c. CR Aircraft (applicable for Controller Aircraft)

14.5.2 System shall aggregate the CR requirements to allow the Controllers to maintain an overview of the national demand and the allocation status of the various CR categories to facilitate him/her to source from the national supply pool and allocate suitable CR owners or assets to the ReqCens.

14.5.3 System shall display the list of CR requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the selected ReqCen. Upon selection of a different ReqCen, system shall display the list of requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the newly selected ReqCen.
14.5.4 System shall display a prompt for the Controllers to review any new suggestion for allocation from AAP. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
14.5.5 On click of allocation summary, system shall display CR owner allocation details for the Controllers to perform allocation.

14.5.6 For each CR category required by the ReqCen, system shall display the relevant information, grouped into four key tabs: a. Allocated CR Owner  System shall display the list of CR owners allocated to the ReqCen for the selected CR category upon expansion of the allocation summary.

14.5.7 o When the Controller updates an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity. f. Automatic Allocation Program  System shall display the list of suggested CR owners and quantity.  On individual row item click, system shall allow update of “Allocate To This ReqCen” quantity.  On ‘Accept Allocation’ button click, system shall prompt for Controller’s confirmation to replace the current allocation with the AAP allocation. Upon confirmation, system shall proceed to replace the current allocation and delete the AAP suggestion from the database.  On ‘Ignore’ button click, system shall delete the AAP suggestion from the database. System shall also delete the prompt for the Controller to review the AAP suggestion.  System shall automatically refresh AAP suggestion based on pre- defined business rules.  To edit quantity for Automatic Allocation Program, o When the Controller edits the quantity and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated displayed at the “Allocated” tab “Substituted” tab, as well as the allocation quantity displayed at summary. o When the Controller edits the quantity and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.

title: Manage Unit/EE Allocation
acceptance_criteria: 14.6.1 System shall restrict by CR types according to the respective Controller’s access rights, a. b. c. 14.6.2 CR Vehicles, CR Heavy Plants (applicable for Controller Vehicles) CR Vessels, CR Craft (applicable for Controller Vessels) CR Aircraft (applicable for Controller Aircraft) System shall display the list of CR requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the selected ReqCen. Upon selection of a different ReqCen, system shall display the list of requirements and allocation summary grouped by CR category for the newly selected ReqCen. OFFICIAL (CLOSED) OFFICIAL (CLOSED)
14.6.3 System shall display the list of Unit/EE that has requirements for the selected CR category when the Controller clicks on allocation summary.
14.6.4 System shall filter the list of Unit/EE by search key against Unit or EE name.
14.6.5 When Controller clicks on specific Unit/EE, system shall display the list of CR Owners allocated to the ReqCen for the CR category.

14.6.6 To manage CR Owners Allocated to Unit/EE, a. On individual row item click, system shall allow Controller Vehicles to update “Allocate To This Unit/EE” quantity. b. When the Controller clicks on Action button, system shall display a popup message on CR assets belonging to the CR Owners to perform individual asset allocation to Unit/EE. c. To Update Unit/EE Allocation,  When the Controller selects an allocation and clicks on ‘√’, system shall save the input quantity and refresh the total sum of quantity allocated at Unit/EE as well as the allocation quantity displayed at the summary.  Any decrease in allocated quantity shall result in deletion of all individual CR assets allocated based on the selected CR category for the CR owner.  Any changes in allocated quantity for Unit/EE shall refresh the allocated quantity for ReqCen.  When the Controller selects an allocation and clicks on ‘X’, system shall discard changes to input quantity.
14.6.7 Controllers shall be able to search using keywords. On the screen, he/she shall be able to fill out the search field and fields allowable for search shall have text hint of the search field.
